name: Mother's Eye
storyline: At night, you watch your mother through the cameras. But the deeper you go, the more the house itself invites you to explore. Step into the dark, discover what is happening to her, and face the truth hiding behind every door.
summary: In this atmospheric psychological horror experience, players take on the role of a son monitoring his mother through a home security system at night. What begins as simple observation quickly spirals into a descent into paranoia. As the house itself seems to shift and invite exploration, you must leave the safety of the monitors to face the unsettling truth hiding behind every door.
